QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_38

question.text: Which of the following is the LEAST preferred (worst-case) exit option from an investee company?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 13.4.3 describes corporate liquidation as the LEAST preferred and WORST-CASE exit option — it is a statutory process with only salvage value and typically implies investee bankruptcy. **The Trap:** IPO is described as the MOST preferred. Trade sale and M&A are middle. Liquidation is worst. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-D tests the same ranking for Cat I/II. Distributor exams test this at the client level. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Provision credit-loss early — once an investee company enters IBC/NCLT, recognition in NAV must reflect expected salvage, not historical cost. Disclose materially impaired positions in the quarterly letter.
